news.title: Trump tells CNBC 'we are very intent on making a deal' with Iran
news.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday said he would order the military to postpone strikes on Iran's power plants and energy infrastructure for five days.

news.title: Volume in stock and oil futures surged minutes before Trump's market-turning post
news.description: The timing of the earlier volume spikes — across both equities and crude — caught the attention of traders.

news.title: Chevron CEO says Iran war impact isn't fully priced into oil market, traders have ‘scant information’
news.description: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth said the physical supply of oil is much tighter than the oil futures market suggests.
